items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: And then I started playing with Leroy Smith.

ctx.x: And then was another guy too, very popular those days, a big man, they called him Joe Jordan. He was a big conductor, writer. So he took me to play one Broadway show called "Fast and Furious." The show didn't last much time. But that was a different idea.
And then I started playing with Leroy Smith. He was a violin player from Philadelphia; violin player, very popular those days. (Inaudible). So from there I went to Noble Sissle orchestra.
